summary.tldr: Appropriates $5.41 billion for federal public service spending in 2025-26.
what_it_does: Appropriates $5,408,955,628 from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the public service of Canada for the year ending 31 March 2026.
Provides money for public service expenses that were not otherwise provided for in that fiscal year.
Came into force on Royal Assent, which was given on 26 March 2026.
summary.background: The President of the Treasury Board introduced the bill in the House of Commons on 24 March 2026. It received Royal Assent on 26 March 2026.
